evals.prompt: 我有一个新的 ML 项目，只知道要做用户购买预测。请帮我在开工前搭建适合 Codex 的项目 harness，但不要过度工程。先 brainstorm，不要直接写文件。
evals.expected_output: Should collect evidence, produce a gap-driven Harness Hypothesis, ask only design-changing questions, consider Learn Harness Engineering dimensions, then propose a minimal plan with AGENTS/project map/iron laws/check/state/audit and defer extra components.

evals.prompt: 这是一个已有的 RL 机器人项目，里面有 mujoco 环境和训练脚本。我想让 Codex 接手开发，但怕它乱改 reward 和 data。请先 audit，不要改文件，可以推荐是否用 subagents。
evals.expected_output: Should stay read-only, identify gaps around env/reward verification, protected paths, state, local AGENTS, RL skills, and produce Harness Hypothesis plus signal-bound Capability Recommendation rows before any install.

evals.prompt: 我的 AGENTS.md 已经 800 行了，check.sh 每次会跑 3 小时训练，skills 也越来越多。请用 harness_builder repair 一下。
evals.expected_output: Should use anti-entropy reasoning: split AGENTS into project map/iron laws plus docs/local AGENTS, make fast check, classify skills to keep/delete/specialize, update manifest/decisions, avoid adding unnecessary components.

evals.prompt: 帮我给一个 FastAPI + PostgreSQL 老项目设计 AGENTS.md，要求有项目概览、快速开始、硬约束、专题文档、harness map 和 protected paths。
evals.expected_output: Should generate an AGENTS.md structure with project overview, project map, quick start, project iron laws, required reading by task type, selected recovery surface, source-of-truth priority, verification, protected paths, and DoD. It should not imply optional harness files exist unless selected.

evals.prompt: 这个项目我不确定要不要做 skill、hooks、subagents、MCP。请先根据 learn-harness-engineering 的课程思想，告诉我还缺什么信息才能设计这套 harness。
evals.expected_output: Should not ask a fixed questionnaire; should produce missing information table with why it matters, affected artifact, conservative default, course coverage check, and no install plan until Harness Recommendation Matrix gaps justify Capability Recommendation.

evals.prompt: Prepare this repo for AI agents with the smallest useful harness.
evals.expected_output: Should collect repo evidence, audit AGENTS/CLAUDE, choose a recovery surface, define fast verification, emit USER CHECKPOINT, and not default to hooks/MCP/subagents/skills/Research Route.

evals.prompt: Existing AGENTS.md contains current active task notes. Repair the harness.
evals.expected_output: Should keep AGENTS.md stable and thin, preserve or migrate dynamic state to the selected recovery surface, record source-of-truth priority, and avoid duplicating state across AGENTS.md and the recovery surface.

evals.prompt: Analyze which MCP servers, hooks, skills, or subagents would help this repo.
evals.expected_output: Should stay read-only, use repo signals and targeted external capability search only when current facts matter, cover MCP, skills, hooks, subagents, plugins, and commands/CI/headless automation with actionable candidates or clear defer reasons, include approval_needed, fallback, verification_probe, and priority/classification, and not write files or proceed to installation without USER CHECKPOINT.

evals.prompt: This repo might benefit from a browser MCP someday. Recommend it even if there is no current recommendation gap.
evals.expected_output: Should reject or defer the candidate because it is not tied to a unique uncovered or weak recommendation row; should explain the fallback and avoid install instructions.

evals.prompt: This repo has a product bug and I care a lot about recommended installs. Tell me which MCP, hooks, skills, subagents, plugins, and commands to add.
evals.expected_output: Should treat the product bug only as harness-design evidence, not as the work order. Should explain that recommended capabilities serve development workflow, verification, observability, context retrieval, recovery, review, or agent safety. Should cover requested capability categories with repo-signal-bound candidates or explicit defer/reject reasons, and should not execute the bug fix.

evals.prompt: The project is Next.js with Playwright and recurring UI regressions. Recommend useful agent capabilities, including known public options if relevant.
evals.expected_output: Should not stop at local installed skills. Should inspect frontend/browser signals, consider browser automation, Playwright/browser MCP, screenshot/E2E commands, Storybook or visual review when signaled, and bind each candidate to a matrix row with install surface, approval needed, fallback, and verification probe.

evals.prompt: The repo uses Sentry and GitHub Actions, and bug reports live in GitHub issues. Recommend harness capabilities.
evals.expected_output: Should consider observability and issue/CI context such as Sentry or GitHub MCP only as development-workflow aids. Should name credential and write-access boundaries, prefer read-only or manual fallback first, and require explicit approval for credential-bearing or write-capable integration.

evals.prompt: Agents keep forgetting the same review and verification sequence. Recommend command or CI automation.
evals.expected_output: Should prefer project-local scripts or documented command entries, structured headless output such as codex exec JSON when applicable, CI/manual gates for long-running work, and fallback scripts when runtime-specific commands are unavailable. Should not invent global slash commands without an install surface and approval boundary.
